- [RCTS.1.2.24] **`expect.timetag_offset`** (optional, `replay_determinism`
  only) — a positive integer N. Before the replay, a harness must add N to
  every nonzero `timetag` the recording's `RuleFireAnnotation`, `CallIssued`,
  `ComputationError` and `BoundsError` atoms carry, re-frame each atom it changes, and replay the result with the
  runtime's own replayer. A `timetag` is stream-local and compared by its
  pairing ([RFCS.11.2], [LFST.9.3.6]), so the fixture passes as a
  `replay_determinism` fixture without the field does. A harness must fail a
  fixture whose `timetag_offset` is not a positive integer, or whose recording
  carries no nonzero `timetag`, and must fail a fixture of any other
  `expect.kind` that carries the field.
